name: quality_score
formula: evaluate_haoping / evaluate when evaluate > 0 else null; clamp to [0,1]; round to 4 decimals
description: 好评率派生指标，由 evaluate_haoping/evaluate 计算，源字段缺失时写 null 不阻塞 Pipeline

name: stock_health
formula: stock <= 0 -> low; 0 < stock <= alarm -> watch; stock > alarm -> ok; goods_stock_alarm missing defaults alarm=0; stock missing -> null
description: 库存健康度三态枚举（low/watch/ok），基于 stock 与 goods_stock_alarm 阈值比较

name: risk_score
formula: base=0.0; commission_risk_flag=1 -> +0.40; refund_status in {-3,3} -> +0.30; is_lock=1 -> +0.20; order_status=0 AND pay_status=0 AND now-create_time>24h -> +0.10; clamp to [0,1]; round to 4 decimals
description: 订单风险分，四因子加权累加（佣金风险/退款/锁定/24h停滞），最终截断 [0,1]

name: overdue_hours
formula: SLA_HOURS=48; when delivery_time=0 AND Order.pay_time>0 then max(0, (now - Order.pay_time - 48h) / 3600) else null; round to 4 decimals
description: 发货逾期小时数，仅未发货且已支付的包裹计算，基于 48h SLA 阈值

name: order_count
formula: reverse-aggregate via placedByLite Link by member_id; member_id not in aggregation result -> null; in result with count=0 -> 0; otherwise the Order count
description: 跨表聚合派生指标，通过 placedByLite Link 反向聚合按 member_id 计算 Order 数量（D1.5 新增，需 link_aggregator）

name: last_order_days
formula: now - max(Order.create_time) in days (floored); no order or future time -> null or 0
description: 跨表聚合派生指标，距最近一次下单的天数（D1.5 新增，需 link_aggregator）
